about: Collingwood is a town on Nottawasaga Bay in Simcoe County, Ontario, at the base of the Niagara Escarpment’s Blue Mountains. It grew as a Georgian Bay shipbuilding and grain-port town and is now a four-season recreation hub for skiing, cycling, and waterfront living. A historic downtown and harbour define the urban core. About 25,000 people live in Collingwood.
